text.autoconfig.booksmart.title: Book Smart Configuration
text.autoconfig.booksmart.option.stickyC: The recipe variant you click stays selected while the crafting grid has items.
Off restores the vanilla 1.5 second variant rotation.
text.autoconfig.booksmart.option.shiftCl: Vanilla: only fills the grid for one stack, nothing is crafted.
One Stack: crafts a single batch into your inventory and stops.
Everything While Held: keeps crafting while shift stays held; release to stop.
Everything: a single click crafts until the materials run out; close the screen to stop.
text.autoconfig.booksmart.option.remembe: Remembers which variant you last crafted per button, across sessions, and clicks use it instead of the rotation.
Buttons you have never crafted from keep the vanilla rotation.
text.autoconfig.booksmart.option.dropMod: Stop: crafting ends when the inventory is full.
Drop Excess: bank what fits, drop the rest on the ground.
Drop All: drop every crafted item on the ground, never banking.
booksmart.intro.title: Book Smart
booksmart.intro.message: Variants stick to your click. Hold shift to craft all.
